Class Abilities

1st Level

Spellcasting (Intelligence)

  • Effect: Vancian slot-based casting per the Magus Spells Per Day table below, from a narrower Magus spell list focused on self-buffs, melee-enhancing effects, and direct-damage spells rather than Wizard's full utility breadth.
  • DC = 10 + half your Magus level (minimum 1) + Intelligence modifier — see Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula.
  • No spell attack rolls — all harmful or debuffing spells require a save.

Spellstrike

  • Effect: As part of a normal weapon attack with your bonded weapon type, you may deliver a spell through the strike.
  • The attack roll is a normal weapon attack (vs AC, your own BtH — not a spell attack roll).
  • If the attack hits, the spell's effect triggers on the same target immediately, resolving however that spell normally would (automatic, or a save against your Magus DC).
  • No separate action is spent.
  • You may Spellstrike once per round; if the attack misses, the spell is lost and any slot spent on it is expended.
  • Cantrip Spellstrike: at-will, no slot cost. Deals 1d4 force damage through the strike (2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th). This is what you do most rounds — it keeps Magus doing something better than a bare weapon hit without burning resources.
  • Levelled Spellstrike: from 3rd level, expend a prepared spell slot to deliver that spell's full effect through the strike instead.
  • The strike also deals bonus damage of the spell's damage type (force if it has none): +1d6 for a 1st- or 2nd-level spell, +2d6 for a 3rd- or 4th-level spell.
  • This is the nova option — limited per day, meant for the rounds that matter.
  • Eligible spells: Spellstrike delivers only a spell that targets a single creature (a touch, a ray or one target at range).
  • Area spells, self-only spells and spells with several targets cannot be delivered.
  • The target makes any save as normal.
  • On a critical hit, only the weapon's own dice add their maximum (see Critical Hits & Critical Fails in The Arneyan Codex); the spell and the Spellstrike bonus dice are rolled normally.
  • A spell held over by First Cut uses that round's Spellstrike.

Arcane Cascade

  • Effect: After a Spellstrike (cantrip or levelled) that hits, gain +1 AC for 1 round — the backwash of channelling a spell through a weapon rather than letting it go cleanly keeps your guard up.

7th Level

War Magic

  • Effect: When you cast a cantrip as your action, you may make one weapon attack with your bonded weapon type immediately afterwards.

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional attack with your bonded weapon type as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). Spellstrike may be delivered through either attack, still once per round.

15th Level

Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence

20th Level

Everstrike

  • Effect: Once per day, your next Levelled Spellstrike costs no slot.

24th Level

  • Everstrike improves: twice per day, and one Spellstrike may deliver two different prepared spells through the same hit.

Feats of Arneyan

  • As a hybrid class (like Bard, Paladin, Ranger, Gunslinger, Swashbuckler and Artificer), the Magus may choose from either Martial Path or Arcane & Devout Path at any Feat level without needing to multiclass. A Magus with the Shadow Edge kit may also choose from the Specialist Path.

Kits — Arneyan Magus Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Magus folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. All Kits share the same Spellstrike/Arcane Cascade baseline above; the Kit determines the flavour and a 1st-level payoff on top.

Magus Spells Per Day

  • Slots follow the Sorcerer's table two rows behind (a 7th-level Magus has the slots of a 5th-level Sorcerer), up to the maximum spell level of 4th.
  • A Magus has no spell slots at 1st and 2nd level, only cantrips and Cantrip Spellstrike.
  • Cantrips are cast at will.
  • Bonus spells from high Intelligence apply once the Magus is high enough level to cast that tier.

Magus Spell List

Spells available to the Magus, by level. * = reversible spell.

  • Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.
  • Includes every Wizard-list spell of the Magus’s favoured schools (Evocation and Abjuration), up to the highest spell level the Magus can cast, except Stoneskin and Melf's Minute Meteors.

0 Level (Cantrips)

Arcane Mark · Dancing Lights · Detect Magic · Detect Poison · Endure Elements · Fire Bolt · Light · Mending · Ray of Frost · Resistance

Alarm · Burning Hands · Feather Fall · Hold Portal · Jump · Mage Armour · Magic Missile · Protection from Alignment · Shield · Shocking Grasp · Spider Climb · Tenser's Floating Disc · Thunderwave
